knownLimitations: 3.0.29 has signed Release AVD upgrade-smoke evidence and authenticated Direct E2E evidence for login, chat, network/session recovery, local chat attachment and content-kit output planning.

The client correctly blocks the empty request. Reference-image generation therefore remains unaccepted until verified with a real input path or corrected test-driver transport.
The shared Playwright cache is locked and checked by android:doctor, but the repository does not yet contain a pinned Playwright package or OAuth/WebView/download-page browser suite.
